title: Instagram Scraper API
description: Select an operation and enter its target.

target.title: Target
target.description: Username, numeric ID, shortcode, hashtag, or search term, depending on the selected operation.

usernames.title: Usernames
usernames.description: For the profile operation, enter multiple usernames here and leave Target empty.

count.title: Page size
count.description: Optional size for posts, tagged posts, followers, following, comments, and user search.

max_id.title: Page cursor
max_id.description: Optional next_max_id from a previous page of posts, tagged posts, followers, following, hashtag posts, or location posts.

min_id.title: Comments cursor
min_id.description: Optional next_min_id from a previous page of comments.

query.title: Name filter
query.description: Optional name filter for followers or following.

sort_order.title: Comment sort order
sort_order.description: Optional for comments. Recent is the default and supports cursor pagination.
